items.title: Execution branch is kylie/post-photo-feature
steps: Confirm current branch is kylie/post-photo-feature branched from dev
items.expected: Branch matches plan; modern feed composer present.
items.evidence: Branch kylie/post-photo-feature merged dev @ 0.1.25; FeedComposer + PostCard present.

items.title: Select multiple photos in FeedComposer (up to 10)
steps: Select 3+ images from device (multi-select if OS allows, or add in batches)
Confirm thumbnail strip shows all selected images side-by-side
items.expected: Up to 10 images attach with previews; 11th rejected with clear feedback.
items.notes: Composer cap + pickError wired; needs manual UI pass.

items.title: Reorder images before posting
items.precondition: Composer has at least 3 images selected
steps: Use reorder controls on the thumbnail strip to move the middle image to first
items.expected: Posted carousel opens on the reordered first image; swipe order matches composer order.
items.notes: Chevron reorder restored in FeedComposer; needs manual UI pass.

items.title: Feed carousel swipe / scroll
steps: Swipe or drag-scroll horizontally on the post media area
Observe dot or position indicator if present
items.expected: Each image is a full-width card; horizontal navigation works on touch and trackpad; no vertical page hijack.

items.title: Single-image posts unchanged
items.precondition: Existing single-image post on feed OR post one new single photo
steps: View the post on Feed and Post detail
items.expected: Single image renders as today (no empty carousel chrome); no regression in layout.

items.title: Shared post embed shows multi-image carousel
items.precondition: Friend has a multi-image original; mutual friendship
steps: Inspect nested embed on your shared card
items.expected: Nested embed shows the same carousel (or first image + count) — not only the cover image silently.

items.title: API rejects invalid image URLs
steps: POST /api/posts with imageUrls containing a non-/uploads/ path
items.expected: 400 validation error; no post row created.
items.notes: Zod UPLOAD_PATH_RE validation unchanged; needs authenticated curl.

items.title: Build gate
items.precondition: All tasks merged on execution branch
items.expected: No errors introduced by this feature.
items.evidence: npm run build @ 0.1.25 — api tsc + frontend tsc/vite green.
